name: careerveda-backend

scripts._comment:test: Both runners. CI calls `npm test` (via test:all) and nothing else, so a script that ran only vitest left tests/unit — sanitize, validate, permissions, password strength — passing on a developer's machine and never executing on a pull request. Jest first because it is three seconds against vitest's ninety, so a broken helper fails fast.
scripts._comment:jest: node --experimental-vm-modules, not NODE_OPTIONS=, so the flag works the same on Windows and CI without cross-env.

_comment:overrides: GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg — unbounded brace expansion crashes the process with OOM. Fixed only in brace-expansion 5.0.8; no 1.x or 2.x patch exists, and jest reaches both (minimatch 3 via test-exclude, minimatch 9 via @jest/reporters). Neither is attacker-reachable — the only patterns expanded are our own test globs — but there is no cost to forcing the fixed release, and 5.0.8 still publishes a CommonJS build so minimatch 3's require() keeps working. Drop this when jest ships a tree that no longer pulls minimatch 3.
